headline: Adds Auction House item dimming and new search filters for auctionable and lootable items.

entries.title: Dim unauctionable items at the Auction House
entries.details: Items that cannot be posted are now dimmed while the Auction House window is open.

entries.title: Search keyword for auctionable items
entries.details: You can now search and create category rules using the auctionable filter (alias ah) for items that can be posted on the Auction House.

entries.title: Search keyword for lootable items
entries.details: You can now search and create category rules using the lootable filter for containers waiting to be opened.
